description: This file defines API routes related to 'reactions' in a FastAPI backend. It includes endpoints for creating reactions and retrieving reactions for a match, interacting with database models Reaction, Match, and Emoji, and utilizing dependency injection for database sessions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI class used for defining route groups.

methods.name: create_reaction(reaction: ReactionCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new reaction, verifying match and emoji existence before adding the reaction to the database.

methods.name: get_match_reactions( match_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 1000, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all reactions associated with a specific match, with pagination parameters.

ctags.signature: ( match_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 1000, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
